requirements.source: User accepted a representative commercial hair dryer as a common design basis on 2026-09-27

operatingReference.mode: COLD, described in the manual as strong cold air
operatingReference.nozzle: built-in quick-dry nozzle, described as a combination of strong and weak streams
operatingReference.catalogueFlowNotes: 1.6 JIS at outlet and 3.0 proprietary hair-reaching metric are not a measured cold velocity profile
operatingReference.scopeWarning: The manual restricts use to human hair drying/styling. Used here as an operating-specification reference for calculations, not authorization to operate the appliance outside its instructions.

publishedColdExperiment.authors: Timothy C. Scott; Lemuel T. Curran
publishedColdExperiment.title: Laboratory Fixture for Heat Transfer Using a Hair Drier
publishedColdExperiment.mode: cold air over a heated 19mm disc
publishedColdExperiment.velocityInterpretation: reported air velocity at the disc test location; the table does not establish the cross-section maximum, area average or radial Gaussian width
publishedColdExperiment.temperatureNote: Cold-air tests only. The paper's separate 73C hot-air mass-flow/16.8m/s example is not used.
publishedColdExperiment.transferToReferencePanasonic: not measured; adopting the local velocity as a Gaussian peak is explicitly a modeling assumption

coinReference.note: A circulation coin is not a calibrated mass; batch mint tolerances must not be converted to individual bounds.

modelAssumptions.fanSetting: COLD on the reference appliance; analogous Hi cold airflow for the published example, not an equality of actual fan outputs
modelAssumptions.profileWarning: The Gaussian peak, axisymmetry, sigma, +/-20% and +/-10mm are design sensitivity inputs, not measured confidence bounds for any dryer.
modelAssumptions.distanceModel: No extrapolation outside the adopted 150mm plane. Published other distances are reference data, not a fitted Panasonic/ReFa law.

boundedLinkageSearch.fixed: all other original Jansen dimensions; scale 0.7; physically defined 0/180 tripod phasing; no arbitrary body translation or leg stretching
boundedLinkageSearch.objective: reduce active-stance vertical speed and horizontal handoff mismatch while preserving stride, lift, closure and forward direction
boundedLinkageSearch.collisionStatus: UNKNOWN until swept real parts and axial layers are built

candidates.direction: intermediate rotor and generated lightweight structure

massAndResistancePolicy: Carry over identical R2 mass bounds and friction/drag ranges for isolated comparisons. Larger rotor proxy mass is added to each design's load, never silently reduced by an unbuilt lightweight frame.

bearingInterfaceUpdate.retailerDesignation: ISC 686ZZ, not proven identical to the catalogue 686AZZ1

candidateSpacerRetail.taxBasis: retail displayed price, no separately stated tax amount extracted
candidateSpacerRetail.availabilityText: structured data InStock; Tokyo earliest arrival 2026-09-29 displayed, not a stock guarantee

bearingInterfaceUpdate.decision: REJECT this 8mm-OD spacer for a 7.4mm maximum shielded shoulder. Catalogue/retailer suffix mismatch must be closed. Do not silently install it or change to open bearings.
bearingInterfaceUpdate.requiredDesignChange: Keep direct 15mm collar contact forbidden. Select a ring-compatible standard spacer or a different fully documented bearing/retention set before final CAD release.

bearing.manufacturer: NSK (Nippon Seiko), not identified as NSK Micro
bearing.availabilityText: lead time 1-2 days displayed; not a reservation

collar.catalogueDate: 2022-09; current dimensions must be confirmed before release

documentedSupportFallback.decision: One documented candidate set, NOT selected into the R3 calculations. Larger 19mm housing, exact NSK 626ZZ inner-face dimensions, current collar revision, drag, added mass and retail price still need to close.
documentedSupportFallback.spacerSubstitution: No loose 8mm spacer is added; the integrated boss is intended to contact the inner ring.
documentedSupportFallback.whyNotAutomaticPass: NSK Micro 626ZZ1 shielded shoulder table has max8.5mm, different from collar boss9.2mm. This does not prove a conflict for NSK 626ZZ, but proves suffix/brand identity cannot be assumed.
